nodes.nie.text.t: "Suit yourself. I sit here and I'll go on sitting here, and the sheep go missing every night."

nodes.pytanie.options.[zgoda].text.t: Thought it over. I'll take it.

nodes.pytanie.text.t: "Ah, the ragamuffin's back. Thought it over? Coin's coin, and the pay's sure. Wolves won't kill themselves, though by a hundred devils I wish they would."

nodes.zgoda.text.t: "There, you see. You've got some sense in your head after all. A day up the stream, the ears for proof."
